aka: 聯發科技創業投資股份有限公司

current_fund.raw: $300 million fund taken directly from MediaTek's balance sheet

strategy.thesis: Strategic investment arm of MediaTek, a leading fabless semiconductor company. Invests at venture and expansion stages, globally and not constrained by geography, in semiconductor, system & device, internet-infrastructure and IT startups, helping them build relationships with global technology partners.

people.name: Ming-Kai Tsai (蔡明介)
people.role: MediaTek Chairman (set up the venture unit)

application.how_to_apply: Pitch MediaTek Ventures directly; strategic investor focused on its semiconductor/system ecosystem.

summary.en: MediaTek Ventures is the strategic corporate VC arm of MediaTek, Taiwan's flagship fabless chipmaker. It deploys a US$300M fund from MediaTek's balance sheet into venture- and expansion-stage startups across Greater China, Europe, Japan and North America, concentrating on semiconductor, system/device, internet infrastructure and IT companies. Portfolio includes ScaleFlux, NeuroBlade and RealSense.
summary.local: 聯發科技創業投資（MediaTek Ventures）是台灣晶片設計龍頭聯發科旗下的策略型企業創投，動用聯發科資產負債表上的 3 億美元基金，投資大中華、歐洲、日本與北美的創投與擴張期新創，聚焦半導體、系統與裝置、網路基礎設施與資訊科技領域，投資組合包含 ScaleFlux、NeuroBlade、RealSense 等。

strategy.thesis: Evergreen corporate venture capital arm 100% owned by UMC, a leading global semiconductor foundry. Invests globally and strategically via venture-capital methods (any round/stage) and M&A, leaning on 40+ years of deep-tech operating experience; focus areas include semiconductors, automotive-related, industrial automation and digital health.

application.how_to_apply: Approach UMC Capital directly through its offices in the US, China and Taiwan.

summary.en: UMC Capital (宏誠創投) is the evergreen corporate VC arm wholly owned by United Microelectronics Corporation (UMC), a top-tier semiconductor foundry. Founded in 2001 and headquartered in Taipei, it manages an evergreen structure with US$800M of committed capital across 4 global offices, investing in semiconductors, automotive, industrial automation and digital health in the US, China and Taiwan.
summary.local: 宏誠創投（UMC Capital）是全球半導體晶圓代工大廠聯華電子（UMC）100% 持股的常青型企業創投，2001 年成立、總部位於台北，以常青基金架構管理約 8 億美元承諾資本，於全球 4 個據點布局，投資美國、中國與台灣的半導體、車用、工業自動化與數位健康領域。

name.local: 創新工業技術移轉股份有限公司

aum.raw: invested over US$400 million across the globe (cumulative since 1979)

strategy.thesis: The venture arm of the Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI), Taiwan's flagship applied-R&D consortium. Invests across all stages and sectors with access to 6,000+ ITRI tech experts and 25,000+ patents; was an original shareholder of industry-defining spinouts such as UMC, AUO and Epistar.

application.how_to_apply: Contact ITIC directly; manages both an evergreen fund and several government/public funds.

summary.en: ITIC (創新工業技術移轉) is the venture-capital arm of ITRI, Taiwan's leading applied-R&D institute. Founded in 1979, it has cumulatively invested over US$400M across all stages and sectors and was an original shareholder of UMC, AUO and Epistar. Beyond its evergreen fund it manages public funds for Taiwan's National Development Fund (Golden Asia Fund I-III, Digital Economy Fund, Taiwan ITRI Entrepreneur Fund).
summary.local: 創新工業技術移轉（ITIC）是台灣工業技術研究院（ITRI）旗下的創投，1979 年成立，累計投資超過 4 億美元，橫跨各階段與產業，並為聯電（UMC）、友達（AUO）、晶元光電（Epistar）等產業領導者的原始股東。除常青基金外，亦為國發基金管理金亞洲基金 I-III、數位經濟基金與工研院創業基金等公共基金。

name.local: 緯創創業投資股份有限公司

current_fund.raw: funded with up to NT$3.5 billion

strategy.thesis: Newly incorporated (board-approved May 2025) wholly-owned corporate VC subsidiary of Wistron, a major ODM/EMS manufacturer. Identifies and co-invests in strategic startups aligned with Wistron's roadmap in AI, IoT, cloud, cybersecurity, EdTech and MedTech, leveraging the Wistron Accelerator (powered by AppWorks) and Wistron Lab @ Garage+.

track_record.portfolio_count: 50–60 strategic startup investments historically (across Wistron group, over NT$10 billion)

application.how_to_apply: Engage via the Wistron Accelerator (powered by AppWorks) or Wistron Lab @ Garage+, or pitch the Corporate Venture Capital Office directly.

summary.en: Wistron Ventures Corporation (緯創創投, WVC) is the wholly-owned corporate VC subsidiary of Wistron, a top-tier Taiwanese ODM/EMS maker. Board-approved in May 2025 with up to NT$3.5 billion, it identifies and co-invests in strategic startups in AI, IoT, cloud, cybersecurity, EdTech and MedTech, building on Wistron's prior NT$10B+ of strategic investments across 50-60 companies and feeding from the Wistron Accelerator (powered by AppWorks).
summary.local: 緯創創業投資（Wistron Ventures, WVC）是緯創資通 100% 持股的企業創投子公司，2025 年 5 月經董事會核准設立，資本額上限 NT$3.5 億元（新台幣 35 億元），鎖定 AI、IoT、雲端、資安、教育科技與醫療科技的策略性新創進行共同投資，並與緯創加速器（由 AppWorks 營運）及 Wistron Lab @ Garage+ 串接。緯創過去策略投資累計逾新台幣 100 億元、橫跨 50–60 家公司。

summary.en: Pegatron Venture Capital (和碩創投) is the investment arm of Pegatron, a leading Taiwanese ODM/EMS manufacturer. It makes strategic technology investments aligned with Pegatron's core business and emerging sectors; recent deals include AI-chip startup Rebellions (Series C) and an exit from Health2Sync.

name.local: 宏達電 Vive X 加速器

check_size.raw: between $100-200k USD (or equivalent), usually as a convertible note; early reports cited $50,000–$200,000

strategy.thesis: HTC's global corporate accelerator and investment program for startups at the intersection of VR, AR, AI and 5G (XR). Backs early-stage companies through convertible notes and helps build the XR ecosystem around HTC's Vive headsets.

program.location: San Francisco, London, Beijing, Taipei, Tel Aviv

track_record.portfolio_count: over 100 deals across six global locations

application.how_to_apply: Apply through the Vive X program website; regional hubs cover their own areas.

summary.en: Vive X is HTC's global corporate accelerator and VC program, launched in 2016 with a US$100M fund (mostly from HTC) to invest in startups at the intersection of VR, AR, AI and 5G. Teams typically receive US$100k-200k via convertible notes for a small equity stake; the program runs hubs in San Francisco, London, Beijing, Taipei and Tel Aviv and has done 100+ deals.
summary.local: Vive X 是宏達電（HTC）2016 年成立的全球企業加速器與創投計畫，初始基金 1 億美元（多來自 HTC），投資 VR、AR、AI 與 5G 交會處的新創。入選團隊通常以可轉換票據獲得 10 萬至 20 萬美元、換取少量股權；計畫在舊金山、倫敦、北京、台北與特拉維夫設立據點，累計超過 100 件投資。

name.local: 鴻海-中信 EV 產業基金（Foxconn Co-GP Fund）

strategy.thesis: Co-GP industry fund set up by Foxconn (Hon Hai) with CTBC Financial Holding, initially to invest in EV-related startups (autonomous driving, EV components) and combine Foxconn's manufacturing scale with CTBC's financial expertise. Part of Foxconn's broader '3+3' strategy across EV, digital health, robotics, AI, semiconductors and next-gen communications.

application.how_to_apply: Strategic / institutional fund; approach Foxconn's investment office.

summary.en: HH-CTBC Partnership, L.P. (the 'Foxconn Co-GP Fund') is the EV-focused industry fund Foxconn (Hon Hai) set up with CTBC Financial Holding in 2021, targeting NT$5-10B (US$179M-$358M). It invests in EV-related startups — autonomous driving and EV components — and co-led the US$50M Series B of Indonesian EV maker PT Ilectra Motor Group (ALVA). It sits within Foxconn's wider corporate-venture activity spanning EV, robotics, AI, semiconductors and digital health.
summary.local: HH-CTBC Partnership, L.P.（即「Foxconn Co-GP Fund」）是鴻海（Hon Hai）2021 年與中信金控合資設立、聚焦電動車的產業基金，募資目標 NT$50–100 億元（約 1.79–3.58 億美元），投資自動駕駛與電動車零組件等 EV 相關新創，並共同領投印尼電動機車廠 PT Ilectra Motor Group（ALVA）的 5,000 萬美元 B 輪。此為鴻海橫跨電動車、機器人、AI、半導體與數位健康之企業創投布局的一環。
